title: [MTR4] Low Effort British FLIRTs
description: Low effort British FLIRTs for MTR mod!
body:
# Low effort British FLIRTs
Adds the Class 745, 755 and 231, retextured from a CAF-Train from the base mod.

**VERSION 2 JUST RELEASED!!! This update includes the brand new Class 755 and Class 231.**
------
![Banner image for LERT British FLIRTs Version 2, showcasing the updated, now MTR4 native train & the new variants](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4629d08ce2cba7420f2db28f6fa5a55b58e76d6.png)
## Features
- The trains
- New original motor sounds
- Customised interior seats
